posts.text: I stopped calling it “procrastination.” Now I call it “creative buffering.”
ADHD means living in a constant loop of motivation, chaos, and guilt.
Digital clutter = ADHD kryptonite. Relatable? This hit.
People with ADHD sees deadlines as plot twists and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.
Just because you’re managing without ADHD meds doesn’t mean life isn’t harder than it needs to be
That feeling is healing parts of me I thought would always hurt
